name: Fabric.AI Inc.
summary: Based in New York and established in 2017, Fabric.AI, Inc. operates as a fabless semiconductor company, specializing in the innovation and creation of advanced chip technologies. Their expertise encompasses MicroLED-based optical interconnect systems, as well as a comprehensive suite of semiconductor solutions specifically engineered for demanding artificial intelligence workloads. The company is also actively involved in the research, development, and eventual market launch of an interface designed to facilitate direct GPU-to-GPU connectivity, with the goal of producing a functional prototype and demonstration version of this cutting-edge technology. Fabric.AI, Inc. adopted its current name in April 2026, having previously operated as StableX Technologies, Inc.
